fact: From July 2024 to January 2025 ACF and IRC ran a decadal agricultural surveillance system for Timbuktu and Youwarou using Sentinel-2 NDVI, built in partnership with state agriculture sectors and the regional early-warning directorate, with a public dashboard.
title: Bulletin de surveillance agricole à Tombouctou et Youwarou au Mali - Saison 2024-2025
publisher: Action Contre la Faim / International Rescue Committee
